sql:
SELECT r.room_no,
			u.usernum AS partner_usernum,
			u.name AS partner_name,
			u.team AS partner_team,
			u.level AS partner_level,
			(SELECT m.content FROM chat_message m
			 WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no ORDER BY m.message_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message,
			DATE_FORMAT(r.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_message_at,
			(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m
			 WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no
			   AND m.sender_usernum != ? AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count
		FROM chat_room r
		JOIN user u ON u.usernum = CASE WHEN r.user_a = ? THEN r.user_b ELSE r.user_a END
		WHERE ? IN (r.user_a, r.user_b)
		ORDER BY COALESCE(r.last_message_at, r.created_at) DESC, r.room_no DESC
